extension.description: Generate Conventional Commit messages with mainstream cloud and local LLM providers.
command.generateMessage.title: AI Commit: Generate Message
configuration.title: AI Commit
configuration.provider.description: LLM provider used to generate commit messages.
configuration.baseUrl.description: Provider base URL. Leave empty to use the selected provider's default.
configuration.apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. This is sensitive data; store it only in trusted machine-local settings and never commit it to source control.
configuration.model.description: Model identifier sent to the selected provider.
